cards.name: Stoic Builder
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may return target land card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Tyranid Invasion
cards.oracle_text: Create a number of 3/3 green Tyranid Warrior creature tokens with trample equal to the number of opponents you have.

cards.name: Aether Herder
cards.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, you get {E}{E} (two energy counters).
Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {E}{E}. If you do, create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.

cards.name: Capenna Express
cards.oracle_text:
Sacrifice a Treasure: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
Crew 3 (Tap any number of creatures you control with total power 3 or more: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.)

cards.name: Curious Forager
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may forage. When you do, return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand. (To forage, exile three cards from your graveyard or sacrifice a Food.)

cards.name: Snapping Creeper
cards.oracle_text: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, this creature gains vigilance until end of turn.

cards.name: Professional Wrestler
cards.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")
This creature can't be blocked by more than one creature.

cards.name: House Cartographer
cards.oracle_text: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card. Put that card into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
